desc: Keep delicious frozen fruit on hand with Cascadian Farm Organic Antioxidant Blend Harvest Berries. These organic strawberries, blackberries, and blueberries are Non-GMO Project Verified and certified USDA Organic. They're great for smoothies, oatmeal, baking, and beyond. Best of all, this frozen fruit mix is rich in the antioxidant vitamin C. Just thaw this frozen fruit mix in the refrigerator or the microwave according to the directions on pack. Stock up on Cascadian Farm frozen organic fruit so you have berries ready for any recipe. Always Organic. Never Ordinary. That's been our mantra since 1972. Since then, we've remained a producer of organic cereals, fruits, vegetables, granola, and snack bars. Cascadian Farm is a pioneering supporter of farmers who use practices that regenerate the land and their communities.
features: Frozen Harvest Berries are a perfect blend of taste, nutrition, and convenience. Packed at the peak of freshness, these berries retain their natural flavor, color, and nutrients without the need for preservatives. They are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and fiber, making them a healthy addition to smoothies, desserts, breakfast bowls, or even as a quick snack. One of the biggest benefits is their long shelf life, allowing you to enjoy fresh-tasting berries any time of the year. With no need for washing or chopping, they save you time in the kitchen while still delivering great taste and nutrition in every bite.
ingredients: Organic Whole Strawberries, Organic Blackberries, Organic Blueberries.
